sections.title: Habit and diversity
sections.text: Cucumis melo is a trailing or climbing annual with tendrils, cultivated for melons and some forms eaten as vegetables. Stem length and fruit size vary greatly among cultivars and growing conditions; fruits may be small or very large, with sweet or non-sweet flesh.

sections.title: Fruit and plate
sections.text: Ripe flesh is eaten and some seeds are also consumed. The plate depicts a cantaloupe-type form with orange flesh, not the full diversity of the species; the stem, tendrils and yellow flowers are consistent.
